lead_raw_text:
The structure of U₂Sb₄AuSb₂ (U(AuSb)₂Sb₂) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 38), with 9 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with 9 geometric neighbors, Sb centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, and U centers with 16 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 9 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Au and Sb polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Sb and U polyhedra.
